title: Adversarial Cooperative Rationalization: The Risk of Spurious Correlations in Even Clean Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Designing an adversarial attacker to inspect whether the model's predictor learns to classify based on trivial, semantically unrelated patterns (spurious correlations) introduced by the generator's selection process. This is evaluated using Attack Success Rate (ASR) and rationale quality metrics (Precision, Recall, F1) on sentiment and graph classification tasks.
